concepts.description: A structural unit in the system architecture that encapsulates functionality and data.
A physical or logical platform that embodies robotic capabilities within the system.
A defined set of interactions or communication points between components.
A component responsible for managing or directing the behavior of other components.
A basic data type predefined by the system, not composed of other types.
A user-defined data type composed of multiple fields of other types.
A callable unit of behavior that performs a specific computation or action.

instances.description: The main module representing the AUV system.
The robotic platform component of the AUV system.
An interface used by the AUV_Platform to access sensor data.
An interface used by the AUV_Platform to control actuators.
A controller handling operator-related inputs in the AUV system.
An interface used by the AUV_Operator to receive input events.
A controller implementing the Last Response Engine functionality.
An interface used by LRE_Ctrl to emit output events.
A controller implementing autopilot functionality for the AUV.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing textual data.
A primitive type representing true/false values.
A primitive type representing real (floating-point) numbers.
A composite type representing a spherical vector with radial, polar, and azimuth components.
A composite type representing an obstacle with relative position, depth, ID, and heading.
An interface defining input events for task control and data requests.
A composite type representing close proximity data with horizontal and vertical coordinates and an identifier.
A function that computes the Euclidean distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
A function that computes the horizontal distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
A function that computes the vertical distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
